task.title: Task form sidebar: tighten dependencies, assignments and attachments
task.description: Visual and wording fixes to the task form sidebar from hands-on validation. Dependencies: no rule under the heading, a slim border per row like assignments and attachments, the title spans the row, Remove becomes the red x used for a pending file, the task ID is dropped from the row, the button reads Add. Assignments: drop the 'assigned x ago' text and the 'Leave blank' helper, Unassign becomes the red x, Assign sits inline with its input. Attachments: Remove becomes the red x, name and metadata get the full width with metadata on one line, a link's URL is shown on hover rather than repeated, the file chooser is styled like the other buttons, Attach sits inline with its inputs. Consistent vertical rhythm across all sidebar sections.
